opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Professional authors resident in the UK or British citizens (fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) for whom author-related activities make up a substantial amount of their annual income; not open to editors, copywriters, or those with salaried income for writing.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants to authors in financial difficulty, to help them return to normal working practice (e.g. lost income, unexpected expenses, illness impact, one-off expenses).

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to writers previously published or with a contract for their project with a commercial UK publisher; accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects; must have a non-contributory contract.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (fiction, non-fiction, poetry, scripts), for research, travel or other general expenditure. Applicants are also automatically considered for related named awards (Eric Ambler, Taner Baybars, John Brooks, Antonia Fraser, Arthur Welton, Great Britain Sasakawa).

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: British authors under the age of 40 (under 40 on Sunday 1 March 2026), British by birth and currently resident in the United Kingdom, who have previously had a work of which they are the sole author published with a commercial UK publisher.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness; accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All authors (anyone who creates work for publication, broadcast or performance); open to UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens; membership not required but must meet SoA membership criteria.
opportunities.summary: Grants for travel, subsistence, childcare/carer support, and access needs for events, residencies, and retreats.

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (as defined by SoA criteria for Full Membership, though membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research manuscript material for a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication.
